# Names the DAX parser rejects as VAR names ("The syntax for '<name>' is incorrect").
# A calculated table that declares one, such as VAR LastDate, is never calculated, and Power BI
# reports that only as a refresh warning. model-step.test.js checks the model the installer builds
# against this list. Matching is case-insensitive.
